title: The Escape Game in Downtown Seattle
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover an immersive adventure at The Escape Game’s Downtown Seattle location. With a variety of unique themes and varying difficulty levels, there’s something for everyone. Step into Hollywood-level sets and embark on a thrilling 60-minute mission filled with puzzles and unlimited clues. We’re close to all the action in downtown Seattle, near top-rated dining, theaters, and iconic attractions like the Seattle Convention Center, the Space Needle, and Pike Place Market. It's perfect for birthdays, team-building events, and unforgettable outings.
